title: Today: CISO Forum Virtual Summit 2026 Day 2 – Join Cybersecurity Leaders Online
description: The CISO Forum Virtual Summit 2026 is a two-day online event designed for senior cybersecurity leaders to discuss and learn about risk management and defense strategies in modern enterprises. The summit focuses heavily on the integration of artificial intelligence in cybersecurity, addressing AI-driven threat landscapes, AI governance, third-party risk management, and team resilience. Sessions cover topics such as securing generative AI, managing cyber risk at machine speed, AI accountability frameworks, and supply chain defense in the AI era. The event aims to provide actionable strategies rather than theoretical discussions, with expert speakers sharing practical frameworks and case studies.
